<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is an </nowiki><strong><nowiki>advanced guide</nowiki></strong><nowiki> which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics, and will go over how to quickly kill Zemouregal &amp; Vorkath with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> only.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is a strong option that can achieve 30+ kph without hybridding, and can comfortably achieve the Grandmaster timer while style camping.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=3d8cabf4-4985-47c2-93ce-27465be6aca5 <nowiki>Method 1</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/26435ca5e6aae671e2790dc0b3f09b3d7ac4a81407f1e25768f9a9c2c2b0bdfd.webp" alt="HM Vorkath Flightskip Melee only" kind="addition" /></p>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-1"><ins><nowiki>Method 1</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Apply </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/933079947419983912.png?v=1" alt="powderofprotection" title="powderofprotection" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at bank for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1" alt="amhej" title="amhej" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Utilize </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for reduced damage from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1278853696159088833.png?v=1" alt="vorkath" title="vorkath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and minions, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226475925514.png?v=1" alt="hellhoundpouch" title="hellhoundpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a viable alternative familiar if struggling.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1" alt="dragonscimitar" title="dragonscimitar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>or</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1" alt="annihilation" title="annihilation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be taken.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Loading into Fort Forinthry is very intensive. Reducing draw distance and turning off textures can reduce load times.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is required since this rotation does not skip Zemouregal's </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1" alt="soulstrike" title="soulstrike" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Hit chance on Zemouregal is very tight under </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1" alt="dba" title="dba" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. If brewed down at all or without maximum accuracy, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592044731400252.png?v=1" alt="dragonscimitar" title="dragonscimitar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is necessary to maintain 100% hitchance.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>It is extremely important to control damage to not overphase Vorkath below 765k into flight phase while there is significant &gt;13 sec </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown remaining. If this happens, the chance of a successful kill is low.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Activate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1" alt="ballista" title="ballista" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 2-3 ticks into the first </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Do not activate a 2nd </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1176968204883603497.png?v=1" alt="ballista" title="ballista" kind="icon" /><nowiki> until after Vorkath departs for flight.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Being on task is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> required.</nowiki></p>
